BASELINE.instruction: For the next 3 minutes, please sit comfortably and breathe normally. This will establish your baseline.

INTERVENTION.instruction: The intervention will now begin. Please follow the on-screen pacer and breathing guide for the next 5 minutes.

RECOVERY.instruction: The intervention is complete. Please rest and breathe normally for the next 3 minutes while we measure your recovery.

COMPLETE.instruction: The protocol is complete. Thank you for your participation. Results will be processed shortly.
